message.content:
**Short answer:** Yes – you can file a noise complaint in Atlanta. The city’s noise‑enforcement process is handled by the **Atlanta Police Department (APD)** and the **Department of Public Safety (DPS)**, and you can also bring the issue to your local city council member if you’d like. --- ## How to File a Noise Complaint in Atlanta | Step | What to Do | Where / How | |------|------------|-------------| | **1. Identify the type of noise** | • Residential or commercial
• Daytime vs. nighttime
• Ongoing vs. one‑off | • Helps the city determine the correct enforcement action | | **2. Call 311 (or 911 for emergencies)** | • 311 is Atlanta’s non‑emergency hotline for city services, including noise complaints.
• 911 only for immediate danger or if you’re in danger. | • Phone: **404‑656‑4000**
• Email: **311@atlantaga.gov**
• Online: [Atlanta 311 portal](https://www.atlantaga.gov/311) | | **3. Submit an online form** | • Fill out the “Noise Complaint” section on the 311 portal. | • Link: | | **4. Contact the Department of Public Safety (DPS)** | • DPS handles code‑enforcement aspects of noise violations. | • Phone: **404‑656‑4000** (same as 311)
• Email: **dsp@atlantaga.gov** | | **5. Reach out to your city council member** | • If the issue persists or you want a more direct line of advocacy, contact the council member who represents your district. | • Find your council member: | | **6. Follow up** | • Keep a record of the complaint ID, date, time, and any correspondence. | • You can request updates via 311 or the DPS email. | --- ## Key Legal Reference - **Atlanta Noise Ordinance** (Title 13, Chapter 12 of the Atlanta Municipal Code) prohibits excessive noise that disturbs the peace and quiet of residents. - **Link:** --- ## Quick Contact List | Agency | Phone | Email | Website | |--------|-------|-------|---------| | **Atlanta Police Department (APD)** | 404‑656‑4000 (311) | 311@atlantaga.gov | | | **Department of Public Safety (DPS)** | 404‑656‑4000 | dsp@atlantaga.gov | | | **City Council** | 404‑656‑4000 | council@atlantaga.gov | | --- ### Tips for a Successful Complaint 1. **Be Specific** – Include exact times, dates, and descriptions of the noise (e.g., “loud music from 10 pm to 2 am”). 2. **Provide Evidence** – If possible, attach audio recordings or photos that demonstrate the disturbance. 3. **Document Your Attempts** – Keep a log of when you called, who you spoke to, and any reference numbers given. 4. **Follow Up** – If you don’t hear back within a week, call 311 again and ask for the status of your complaint. --- **Bottom line:** Atlanta’s city government is equipped to handle noise complaints. Use the 311 system or the DPS, and involve your city council member if you need additional support.
